requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with incomplete token detection, particularly for values and names at the end of input. This leads to incorrect return values (None instead of proper token types) which causes parsing failures.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return token types for incomplete tokens at the end of input. Specifically, when a token is incomplete at the end of the text, it should return the appropriate token type (e.g., 'INTEGER', 'REAL', or 'NAME') with the correct boundaries rather than returning None.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function doesn't correctly handle reference objects (like 6 0 R) in dictionary values and arrays. It should convert integers followed by '0 R' into complex number representations (like 6j).
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly parse reference objects in both dictionary values and arrays. When encountering an integer followed by '0 R', it should convert this to a complex number representation (e.g., 6j for 6 0 R).

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with parsing simple objects that are references (not in arrays or dictionaries). It doesn't properly detect and convert standalone reference patterns.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly handle standalone reference patterns (like 6 0 R) when they appear as top-level objects, converting them to complex number representations.

requirement.description: The text_string function doesn't properly handle UTF-8 encoded strings with special characters like euro sign (€). The implementation should correctly decode UTF-8 strings with special characters.
requirement.contract: The text_string function must correctly decode UTF-8 strings containing special characters. Specifically, it should properly handle byte sequences like 0xA0 (Euro sign) when they appear in PDF literal strings.

requirement.description: The next_token function has incorrect handling of comments in parsing. Comments should be skipped properly and should not interfere with subsequent tokenization.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly handle comment tokens. When encountering a '%' character, it should consume the entire comment line (until newline) and return the COMMENT token with correct boundaries.
